executiveSummary.description: Upgraded Spring Boot from 1.5.10.RELEASE to 2.7.18, Java from 1.8 to 17 (targeting Java 21), replaced deprecated APIs (WebSecurityConfigurerAdapter, WebMvcConfigurerAdapter, findOne, save(Iterable), AbstractXlsView, getErrorPath), updated imports (spring4->spring5, hibernate validator->javax.validation), fixed dependency versions and conflicts, and resolved circular bean references. The project compiles successfully with mvn clean test-compile. The single test (CrmApplicationTests.contextLoads) was not run to completion because it requires the application's own MySQL database (jdbc:mysql://localhost:3306/crm) which is not available in this environment.

fixedUpdates.title: Upgrade Spring Boot parent from 1.5.10.RELEASE to 2.7.18
fixedUpdates.impact: Spring Boot 1.x uses Spring 4.3 whose CGLIB cannot run on Java 17+, so the application would not start. Upgrading to 2.7.18 enables Java 17 compatibility.

fixedUpdates.title: Update Java version from 1.8 to 17 and upgrade maven-compiler-plugin
fixedUpdates.impact: maven-compiler-plugin 3.7.0 is too old for Java 21 and source/target 1.8 is not accepted. Upgraded plugin to 3.11.0 and source/target to 17.

fixedUpdates.title: Update thymeleaf-extras-springsecurity4 to springsecurity5
fixedUpdates.impact: thymeleaf-extras-springsecurity4 is only compatible with Spring Security 4; Spring Boot 2.x uses Spring Security 5 requiring thymeleaf-extras-springsecurity5.

fixedUpdates.title: Remove spring-boot-actuator-docs dependency
fixedUpdates.impact: spring-boot-actuator-docs does not exist in Spring Boot 2.x or 3.x; it was removed after Boot 1.x and causes build failures.

fixedUpdates.title: Update thymeleaf-spring-data-dialect from 2.1.1 to 3.1.0
fixedUpdates.impact: thymeleaf-spring-data-dialect 2.x is only compatible with Thymeleaf 2; version 3.1.0 is compatible with Thymeleaf 3 (Spring Boot 2.x).

fixedUpdates.title: Update mysql-connector-java to com.mysql:mysql-connector-j
fixedUpdates.impact: mysql:mysql-connector-java was renamed to com.mysql:mysql-connector-j; the old artifact may not be available or compatible with newer MySQL.

fixedUpdates.title: Remove nekohtml dependency (no longer needed with Thymeleaf 3)
fixedUpdates.impact: nekohtml was only needed for Thymeleaf 2 LEGACYHTML5 mode; removed after migrating to Thymeleaf 3 HTML mode.

fixedUpdates.title: Upgrade itextpdf from 5.5.13 to 5.5.13.3
fixedUpdates.impact: iText 5.5.13 may have reflection issues with Java 17+ module system; 5.5.13.3 fixes compatibility.

fixedUpdates.title: Upgrade Apache POI from 3.15 to 5.2.3
fixedUpdates.impact: Apache POI 3.15 is too old for Java 17+ and has known module system compatibility issues.

fixedUpdates.title: Update bouncycastle artifact from bcprov-jdk15on to bcprov-jdk18on 1.72
fixedUpdates.impact: bcprov-jdk15on artifact on Maven Central only goes up to 1.70; 1.72+ requires the bcprov-jdk18on artifact.

fixedUpdates.title: Upgrade OpenCSV from 4.0 to 5.7.1
fixedUpdates.impact: OpenCSV 4.0 is old; 5.7.1 provides Java 17+ compatibility and fixes.

fixedUpdates.title: Upgrade pdfbox from 2.0.8 to 2.0.27
fixedUpdates.impact: pdfbox 2.0.8 may have compatibility issues with Java 17+; 2.0.27 fixes them.

fixedUpdates.title: Add junit-vintage-engine dependency for JUnit 4 test compatibility
fixedUpdates.impact: Spring Boot 2.4+ ships JUnit 5 only; junit-vintage-engine allows JUnit 4 tests to run on Boot 2.7.

fixedUpdates.title: Remove Jsr310JpaConverters import and EntityScan reference
fixedUpdates.impact: Jsr310JpaConverters was deprecated and removed in Spring Data 2.x; Java 8 time types are natively supported by Hibernate 5.2+.

fixedUpdates.title: Replace WebSecurityConfigurerAdapter with SecurityFilterChain bean
fixedUpdates.impact: WebSecurityConfigurerAdapter is deprecated in Spring Security 5.7 and removed in Spring Security 6; replaced with SecurityFilterChain bean configuration.

fixedUpdates.title: Add @Lazy to UserService injection in SpringDataUserDetailsService to break circular dependency
fixedUpdates.impact: Spring Boot 2.6+ refuses circular bean references by default. SpringDataUserDetailsService and UserServiceImpl inject each other, creating a cycle. @Lazy breaks the cycle.

fixedUpdates.title: Replace WebMvcConfigurerAdapter with WebMvcConfigurer interface
fixedUpdates.impact: WebMvcConfigurerAdapter was deprecated in Spring 5.0 and removed in Spring 6; implementing WebMvcConfigurer directly is the replacement.

fixedUpdates.title: Update Thymeleaf spring4 imports to spring5
fixedUpdates.impact: org.thymeleaf.spring4 packages do not exist in Thymeleaf 3 (Spring Boot 2.x); the correct packages are org.thymeleaf.spring5.

fixedUpdates.title: Update springsecurity4 dialect import to springsecurity5
fixedUpdates.impact: org.thymeleaf.extras.springsecurity4.dialect.SpringSecurityDialect is incompatible with Spring Security 5+.

fixedUpdates.title: Change Thymeleaf template mode from LEGACYHTML5 to HTML
fixedUpdates.impact: LEGACYHTML5 was a Thymeleaf 2 feature removed in Thymeleaf 3; HTML is the correct template mode.

fixedUpdates.title: Remove useJaf(false) call from ContentNegotiationConfigurer
fixedUpdates.impact: useJaf() was removed in Spring 5 as JAF was removed from the JDK; Spring 5 uses its own content detection.

fixedUpdates.title: Merge duplicate templateEngine bean methods, keeping both dialects
fixedUpdates.impact: Two templateEngine bean methods existed, causing a bean definition conflict. Merged into one method keeping both SpringSecurityDialect and Java8TimeDialect.

fixedUpdates.title: Update ErrorController import to new package and remove getErrorPath()
fixedUpdates.impact: ErrorController moved from org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.web to org.springframework.boot.web.servlet.error in Spring Boot 2.x; getErrorPath() was removed from the interface.

fixedUpdates.title: Replace findOne(id) with findById(id).orElse(null) in UserServiceImpl
fixedUpdates.impact: JpaRepository.findOne(id) was removed in Spring Data 2.x; findById(id) returns an Optional.

fixedUpdates.title: Replace findOne(id) with findById(id).orElse(null) for RoleRepository in UserServiceImpl
fixedUpdates.impact: JpaRepository.findOne(id) was removed in Spring Data 2.x; findById(id) returns an Optional.

fixedUpdates.title: Replace findOne(id) with findById(id).orElse(null) in CustomerServiceImpl
fixedUpdates.impact: JpaRepository.findOne(id) was removed in Spring Data 2.x; findById(id) returns an Optional.

fixedUpdates.title: Replace findOne(id) with findById(id).orElse(null) in ContractServiceImpl
fixedUpdates.impact: JpaRepository.findOne(id) was removed in Spring Data 2.x; findById(id) returns an Optional.

fixedUpdates.title: Rename findByEnabledAndCategories and findByCategories to add In suffix in CustomerRepository
fixedUpdates.impact: Spring Data 2.x rejects derived queries that pass a Collection to a non-In operator at startup.
fixedUpdates.originalCode:
Iterable<Customer> findByEnabledAndCategories(int enabled, Set<Category> category);
    Iterable<Customer> findByCategories(Set<Category> category);
fixedUpdates.fixedCode:
Iterable<Customer> findByEnabledAndCategoriesIn(int enabled, Set<Category> category);
    Iterable<Customer> findByCategoriesIn(Set<Category> category);

fixedUpdates.title: Update CustomerService interface method names to match renamed repository methods
fixedUpdates.impact: Interface method names must match the renamed repository methods.

fixedUpdates.title: Update CustomerServiceImpl to call renamed repository methods with In suffix
fixedUpdates.impact: Callers must use the renamed methods with In suffix.

fixedUpdates.title: Replace save(Iterable) with saveAll(Iterable) in ContractServiceImpl
fixedUpdates.impact: Spring Data 2.x changed save(Iterable) to saveAll(Iterable).

fixedUpdates.title: Update Hibernate Validator imports from org.hibernate.validator.constraints to javax.validation.constraints in User entity
fixedUpdates.impact: @Email and @NotEmpty were moved from org.hibernate.validator.constraints to javax.validation.constraints in Hibernate Validator 6 (Spring Boot 2.x).

fixedUpdates.title: Update Hibernate Validator imports from org.hibernate.validator.constraints to javax.validation.constraints in Customer entity
fixedUpdates.impact: @Email and @NotEmpty were moved from org.hibernate.validator.constraints to javax.validation.constraints in Hibernate Validator 6 (Spring Boot 2.x).

fixedUpdates.title: Replace AbstractXlsView with custom AbstractView using Apache POI directly in ExcelView
fixedUpdates.impact: AbstractXlsView was removed in Spring 5; replaced with a custom AbstractView that creates the workbook directly using Apache POI.

fixedUpdates.title: Replace deprecated HSSFColor constants with IndexedColors in ExcelView
fixedUpdates.impact: HSSFColor.BLUE.index and HSSFColor.WHITE.index are deprecated in Apache POI 4+; IndexedColors is the recommended replacement.

fixedUpdates.title: Remove deprecated generateHeader() call in WriteCsvToResponse
fixedUpdates.impact: generateHeader() is deprecated in OpenCSV 4+; removed the call as it is not needed for CSV writing.

fixedUpdates.title: Replace management.security.enabled and management.context-path with management.endpoints.web.base-path
fixedUpdates.impact: management.security.enabled and management.context-path were removed in Spring Boot 2.x; replaced with management.endpoints.web.base-path.

fixedUpdates.title: Change Thymeleaf template mode from LEGACYHTML5 to HTML in application.properties
fixedUpdates.impact: LEGACYHTML5 was a Thymeleaf 2 feature removed in Thymeleaf 3; HTML is the correct mode.

fixedUpdates.title: Update Thymeleaf namespace from springsecurity4 to springsecurity5 in index.html
fixedUpdates.impact: The springsecurity4 namespace is incompatible with Spring Security 5+; springsecurity5 is required.

fixedUpdates.title: Add CsvValidationException handling for OpenCSV 5.x compatibility in CSVTest
fixedUpdates.impact: OpenCSV 5.x's readNext() throws CsvValidationException (a checked exception) in addition to IOException; the catch clause was updated to handle both.

failedUpdates.title: CrmApplicationTests.contextLoads test not run to completion - requires MySQL database
failedUpdates.failureReason: Not run here: The test CrmApplicationTests.contextLoads() starts the full Spring ApplicationContext which requires the application's own MySQL database at jdbc:mysql://localhost:3306/crm (configured in application.properties). This database is not available in the build environment. The test was left as-is (JUnit 4 with SpringRunner) and the junit-vintage-engine dependency was added so it can run when the database is available. The build compiles successfully (mvn clean test-compile passes), but the test cannot be executed without the database.
failedUpdates.suggestedApproach: Run the test against the application's MySQL database when available. The junit-vintage-engine dependency ensures JUnit 4 tests run on Spring Boot 2.7.

reportMetadata.description: Upgraded Spring Boot from 1.5.10.RELEASE to 2.7.18 and Java from 1.8 to 17, resolving all compilation errors. The project compiles successfully with mvn clean test-compile on Java 21. The single test could not be run because it requires the application's own MySQL database which is not available in this environment.
reportMetadata.status: Build compiles successfully; tests not run due to missing MySQL database

postTransformationGuidelines: Spring Boot was upgraded from 1.5.10.RELEASE to 2.7.18 (not 3.x) to avoid the javax-to-jakarta migration. The javax.* imports (javax.persistence, javax.validation, javax.servlet) are kept as-is because Spring Boot 2.7 still uses the javax namespace.

WebSecurityConfigurerAdapter was replaced with a SecurityFilterChain bean. The AuthenticationManager is exposed via AuthenticationConfiguration. antMatchers() is kept (deprecated in Spring Security 5.7 but still functional in Boot 2.7) rather than migrating to requestMatchers() which requires Spring Security 6 / Spring Boot 3.

The @EnableGlobalMethodSecurity annotation is kept (deprecated in Spring Security 5.8 but still functional in Boot 2.7) rather than migrating to @EnableMethodSecurity which requires Spring Security 6 / Spring Boot 3.

Circular bean references were broken by: (1) moving auth configuration into the filterChain bean method with parameters instead of calling @Bean methods from @Autowired methods, and (2) adding @Lazy on the UserService injection in SpringDataUserDetailsService.
The ExcelView was rewritten to extend AbstractView directly instead of AbstractXlsView (removed in Spring 5), using Apache POI's WorkbookFactory.create(true) to create an HSSFWorkbook.
The super-csv dependency was kept at version 2.4.0 as it compiles and works on Java 17.

The CrmApplicationTests.contextLoads test was not run because it requires the application's own MySQL database (jdbc:mysql://localhost:3306/crm) which is not available in this environment. The junit-vintage-engine dependency was added so JUnit 4 tests can run on Spring Boot 2.7 when the database is available.
